description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON documents feed (batch bundle): 2 DocumentReference resources — doc-1 a CCD summary (LOINC 34133-9) as an application/xml attachment and doc-2 a discharge summary (LOINC 18842-5) as an application/pdf attachment — each carrying only the document TYPE code + a content POINTER (url + contentType + title), identity-anchored via the seam, plus 1 malformed record missing the content pointer (quarantine). Tier T2 by design: the attachment is human-readable but NOT parsed; no computable T1 clinical data is claimed. No member names; subjects are source ids anchored through the identity seam.
